cards.name: Comms Override
cards.blurb: Reaction only — play it when another captain acts to jam their comms. Each Override flips the outcome; after everyone has spoken, an ODD number of Overrides cancels the action.

cards.name: Deflector
cards.blurb: Reaction only — and only for the target of an attack. Play it to send the attack at any other captain instead, with its payload +1 (⚡ discards +1 card; 🧲 lets them keep 1 fewer). Each captain deflects once per chain; one 📡 Override kills the whole chain.

cards.name: Forced Flyby
cards.blurb: Skim the next captain’s station: your turn ends with no draw, and they owe 2 extra turns PLUS your remaining debt (max 6 total). More draws = more rupture chances — for them.

cards.name: Emergency Burn
cards.blurb: End this turn immediately WITHOUT drawing. The classic way to dodge a ☀️ you know is waiting at the top of the deck.

cards.name: Deep-Space Scan
cards.blurb: Privately view the top 3 cards of the deck, in order. Information is survival — plan your draw, or someone else’s.

cards.name: Gravity Slingshot
cards.blurb: Shuffle the entire deck. Wrecks everyone’s scan knowledge and secretly-reinserted Ruptures alike. Chaos tool.

cards.name: Emergency Requisition
cards.blurb: Demand supplies: the target captain gives you 1 card — but THEY choose which. Generosity is not guaranteed.

cards.name: Boarding Party
cards.blurb: Grapple and loot: steal 1 RANDOM card from a target captain’s hand. Might be their last 🛡️. They will remember.

cards.name: Course Reversal
cards.blurb: Flip the direction of play, then end this turn without drawing. (With 2 captains it just works as an Emergency Burn.)

cards.name: Salvage Operation
cards.blurb: Rummage the discard pile: take any one card into your hand — except ☀️ Ruptures and 🛡️ Containment Fields.

cards.name: Ion Surge
cards.blurb: Overload a rival's systems: the target jettisons 1 RANDOM card from their hand — gone to the discard pile, not stolen. ↪️ Deflectors can bounce it onward and make it bigger.

cards.name: Tractor Snag
cards.blurb: Snag a rival's cargo bay: the target discards down to 3 cards — THEY choose which to lose. Pointless against a hand of 3 or fewer. ↪️ Deflectors can bounce it onward and make it bite deeper.

cards.name: Micrometeoroid Storm
cards.blurb: Danger — never in your hand. The instant you DRAW it, jettison 1 card of your choice (itself goes to the discard pile). An empty hand shrugs it off.

cards.name: Solar Wind
cards.blurb: A friendly gust — the instant you DRAW it, immediately draw 1 extra card. Chains! In your hand it does nothing… but it pads your hand against 🧲 and thieves.

cards.name: Coolant Cell
cards.blurb: Component. Lone? SCRAP it as your action: discard it to peek at the top card of the deck. Hold TWO matching to siphon: steal 1 random card from a target captain.

cards.name: Hull Plating
cards.blurb: Component. Lone? SCRAP it as your action: discard it to peek at the top card of the deck. Hold TWO matching to siphon: steal 1 random card from a target captain.

cards.name: Solar Rupture
cards.blurb: Catastrophe — revealed the instant you draw it. Hold a 🛡️ Containment Field → it is auto-spent to contain. Hold none → your flagship is disabled: you are out. Ruptures never enter hands.

cards.name: Containment Field
cards.copies: 6 total (1 per player dealt, leftovers in deck)
cards.blurb: Your life insurance — never played by choice. It spends itself automatically when you draw a ☀️ Solar Rupture. There are only 6 in the game.

factions.timing: reaction window, as current target of a targeted attack
factions.effect: Deflector redirect without paying the card; payload grows exactly like ↪️ (+1 on destruction, cap 3); joins chain deflectors; window reopens

factions.timing: reaction window, as target of a requisition
factions.effect: reverses the demand: initiator becomes giver, courtier receives (giftTo); window reopens; initiator may deflect onward; one 📡 kills the exchange
free salvage of any discard card (never rupture/containment) through a real reaction window; one 📡 cancels the grab but the power is already spent
chosen captain jettisons 1 card instead of the drawer; no chain-shouting (redirect final)
one Component played as a completed pair-siphon (Component is paid/discarded); normal pair reaction window; 📡 cancels the steal, power already spent

factions.timing: reaction window, as target of a theft (boarding/pair/requisition)
factions.effect: theft fizzles instantly mid-window (pending=null, attacker's cards stay spent, nothing left to override); works even after redirecting this chain; destruction (⚡/🧲) passes

factions.timing: reaction window, as target of an attack (theft + ion_surge + tractor)
factions.effect: re-aim at any other captain with NO payload growth (existing growth stays); joins chain deflectors; 2-player slides back at the attacker; later ↪️ grows normally
instant private top-3 deck peek; no reaction window (nothing to override); counterplay is a later slingshot shuffle
